For the 8 at (7,1), by symmetry with that pattern, the up branch should mirror the down branch of the example - stepping right and up in two-cell increments through (6,1),(5,1),(5,2),(5,3),(4,3),(3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(2,5),(1,5),(1,6),(1,7),(0,7).
